title: Copper zones on one layer and on two, a zone with no net, and rule areas that keep the pour out
how: Copper zones with a net: GND on B.Cu (1 zone) and SIG with `layers "F.Cu" "B.Cu"` (1 zone for each layer = 2) = 3 zones; the third zone has `net 0` and no name, so it is left out and counted as a zone without a net;
the filled copper is computed again by the tool: the GND zone holds 1 `filled_polygon`, the others none = 1 dropped;

rule areas (a `keepout` in a zone): the first one forbids only copper pour, with tracks, vias and pads allowed, and its 4 corners lie inside the GND zone (x from 20 to 30 inside 1..49, y from 20 down to 10 inside 1..29) = 1 cutout of that zone; it does not lie in the SIG zone on B.Cu (5..10);
the second forbids tracks and vias too, which a cutout cannot say = dropped; the third forbids only the pour but lies at (60..70) outside every zone = dropped: 2 keep-out zones dropped;
a `gr_rect` on Edge.Cuts is a ring of 4 points; nets GND and SIG = 2.
